question: Can the same ordinary local adapters fit the fixed original data with more updates, before interpreting blocked-reader failures as information or capacity limits?
research_scope: Carrier/readout calibration is a diagnostic step within whole-block semantic write/read co-design. It is not a replacement architecture goal.
data_order: Repeat the exact original ordered 128 examples; for microbatch m use encoded[m % 128]. No new examples, shuffling, warm starts or changes to labels.

question_only.description: Preserve pre-question KV/recurrent/convolution computation exactly; adapt only during question/answer processing.

all_tokens.description: Same local targets/parameters; permit prefix as well as question/answer adaptation. Changes both recurrent/convolution state and attention/KV construction.

requirements: Use existing base Conda, local frozen backbone and unchanged GroupController targets; no environment creation, package changes or model copies.
Preserve all original optimizer settings, inputs and reader masks; initialize each arm from the same zero-output state, without warm-starting the previous trained adapters.
At step 64 verify exact adapter-state and loss replay against the corresponding completed reference before proceeding; investigate a mismatch rather than silently treating it as the same protocol.
Save adapter and optimizer state, actual microbatch identities/reader-call counts, source/data/checkpoint hashes and completed-step status so an interrupted run can be resumed without guessing.

Evaluate only the fixed checkpoints on the exact 128 training examples and original validation split. Distinguish teacher-forced numeric-token accuracy, newline accuracy and unrestricted greedy answers.

Do not repeatedly evaluate the original test grid or the 70000-series generalization cohort during this calibration; they have already been inspected. Do not select a winning checkpoint from those data.
Run both arms to the same registered maximum unless a numerical/protocol failure stops the run. Do not use success-based early stopping to create unmatched budgets.

Recheck finite nonzero adapter gradients, absent backbone gradients, actual zero record-attention probabilities and question-only prefix identity before release; verify final-checkpoint prefix preservation on short/long samples.

interpretation.fit_recovers: Additional optimization resolves at least part of the prior negative result; it does not establish semantic generalization or a new architecture.
interpretation.train_fits_validation_fails: Data diversity/generalization is unresolved; compare simple augmentation before adding architectural complexity.
interpretation.both_still_fail_to_fit: Budget, adapter expressivity, target coverage and inaccessible information remain alternatives. Next include single-fact positive controls and explicit GDN-query/readout-capacity controls rather than claiming a state-capacity impossibility.
interpretation.all_token_advantage: Earlier computation changes both recurrent/convolution states and attention/KV construction; this does not isolate GDN write damage.

broader_followups: Replicate promising effects across the two other fixed initializations before a comparative claim.
Add fresh value/position-matched initial-fact and source-before/after-COPY controls with historical queries.
Compare ordinary augmentation/local adaptation and practical learned access with shared write/read co-design at matched cost before claiming architectural value.
